name: Rocket Fuel - (1g) Live Resin - Platinum Cake
description:
Fresh-frozen flavor, straight from the jar. Rocket Fuel Platinum Cake live resin delivers 1 gram of full-spectrum concentrate, extracted from fresh-frozen flower to lock in the terpenes and aroma the plant started with — bold, flavorful, and made for dabbing.

Platinum Cake is an indica-leaning hybrid built on classic dessert-strain genetics, and the flavor delivers: sweet vanilla cake and creamy frosting notes up front, grounded by earthy, subtly gassy undertones and a smooth finish. Because it's live resin, every dab hits with deeper flavor and a fuller, more well-rounded effect — a heavy, soothing calm that's perfect for evenings and full-body relaxation.

Why you'll love it:

1G live resin — fresh-frozen extraction for maximum terpene preservation
Full-spectrum flavor — rich, aromatic, and true to the strain
Signature Platinum Cake flavor — sweet vanilla cake and frosting with earthy, gassy depth
Jar packaging — easy to scoop, easy to store, ready to dab

Big flavor, premium potency, and true-to-plant character in every gram. Rocket Fuel Platinum Cake is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets. Requires a compatible dab rig or vaporizer.
